topic: The Attention Mechanism: How Transformers Read
target_audience: University students with basic programming/math background

sections.title: The Intuitive Hook: The Cocktail Party Effect
lecture_lines: Transformers use selective focus like a party.
Humans filter noise to hear one speaker.
Models filter relevant tokens from a sequence.
animations: Create a room filled with people talking in circles. Color them #888888.
Highlight one person (colored #FFFF00) listening to a specific voice.
Fade out surrounding voices, leaving only the focused connection (colored #FFFF00).

sections.title: The Mechanism: Queries, Keys, and Values
lecture_lines: Queries, Keys, and Values drive the mechanism.
Query: What am I looking for?
Key: What do I have to offer?
Dot products measure similarity between vectors.
animations: Display three vectors Q (colored #FF0000), K (colored #00FF00), V (colored #0000FF).
Show Q interacting with K using a dot product arrow, resulting in a score (colored #FFFF00).
Scale V by the match score to create a weighted output (colored #FFFFFF).
Show the addition of all weighted V vectors.
Present the final output context vector.

sections.title: Visualizing Attention Scores (Softmax)
animations: Represent attention scores as bars of different heights (colored #AAAAAA).
Apply Softmax transformation to normalize bars, making them sum to 1.
Highlight the highest score bar with color #FF00FF.

sections.title: The Mathematical Workflow
lecture_lines: Attention combines Q, K, and V vectors.
We calculate weights via dot products.
Values are summed based on these weights.
The formula represents a weighted mix.
animations: Show matrix multiplication: Input sequence X (colored #FFFFFF) multiplied by W_q, W_k, W_v (colored #8888FF).
Display labels for Q, K, V matrices (colored #FFFF00).
Sum values V weighted by attention weights to get the final matrix output (colored #00FF00).
Present the final formula clearly in the center.

sections.title: Summary: Why Transformers Rule
lecture_lines: RNNs read one word at a time.
Attention processes the entire sequence simultaneously.
animations: Show a Transformer block connecting multiple layers (colored #FFFFFF).
Display a split screen comparing serial RNN processing (slow) vs parallel Attention processing (fast, colored #00FFFF).
Fade in text 'Transformers are powerful' with color #00FFFF.
